t: Ezo mayim kesherim veezo pesulim lintila
s: Ezo mayim kesherim veezo pesulim lintila, ubo y"t seipim: mayim shennishtannu marehem, ben mechamat meqomam ben mechamat dabar shennapal letokan, kegon shennapal letokan deyo o qomos o yayin veshekar veshinnu marehen — pesulim lintilat yadayim. Abal im napal letokam apar vatit, ap al pi sheakarum — kesherim, kemo sheyyitbaer (lepi sheggiddul hammayim hu beapar vatit vedarkam bekak, veen zeh chashub shinnuy). Veim nishtannu mechamat ashan o dabar acher — pesulim. Abal im nishtannu mechamat atzman — kesherim. Vaapillu nishtannu shinnuy happosel, im achar kak chazeru libriyyatan — chazeru lekashrutan:

Asa bammayim melaka, o sheshshara bahem pitto, apillu nitkavven lishrot bikli zeh venapal lashsheni — pesulim lintilat yadayim, lepi shekkesheadam oseh bammayim dabar sheyyesh lo tzorek bo — naasu keshopekin sheomedin lishpika, veen notelin beshopekin. Abal im lo nitkavven lishrot kelal, raq shennapal pat lammayim venishru bahem — kesherim, shello asaam shopekin. Veyesh mi shepposel gam bazeh. Veyesh lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Im hediach bahem kelim o yeraqot — pesulim. Veim hayu kelim mudachim o chadashim, o yeraqot mudachim uneqiyyim — kesherim, sheen zo niqret melaka lipsol hammayim mishshum shopekin, hoil veen bah tzorek, shemmibbaladeha hayu kebar neqiyyim. Umikkol maqom, im shara bahem hayraqot kede shello yikmeshu, veken im natan bahem kelim shennitbaqqeu bimot hachamma kede sheyyitkavvetzu — hare zo melaka upesulim. Veken im natan keli shel yayin letok hammayim letzanneno — pesulim. Abal natan bahem dagim chayyim shello yamutu — en zo melaka, sheen hammayim poalin bahem kelal, raq matztzilin otan mimmita, vegam enan niqraim shopekin. Veken im natan letokam dabar hammeriach kede sheyyarichu — kesherim, shehare enan shopekin shehem kimusim, abal kan nitkavven lehashbicham:

Im hammayim bikli sheyyesh bo shenatot venatan letoko basar veolin hammayim ad hashshenatot ubazeh yodea mishqalo — hare zo asiyyat melaka bammayim, upesulin lintilat yadayim (abal im haya yodea mishqal hammayim veshaqal habbasar kenegdam — kesherim, kevan shello naaset hammelaka begupan):

Im hitbil bahem hannachtom et haggeluseqim, ap al pi shello nishtannu marehem — pesulim. Abal im tabal bahem yadayv vetach pene haggeluseqin, o shechapan mehem bechopnayv — hammayim hannisharim bakkeli lo naasa bahem melaka, shettebilat yadayv bahem enah qeruya melaka ad sheyyadichan bahem, vehu shehayu meluklakot techilla, lepikak kesherim im lo nishtannu marehen. Abal im hediach bahem yadayv mehabbatzeq haddabuq bahem — pesulim, ap al pi shello nishtannu marehen. Veyesh omerim shehadachat yadayim enah chashuba melaka lipsol hammayim lintilat yadayim, kevan sheakshav rotzeh bahem gam ken littol yadayv (upesul melaka enah mishshum shopekin, ella mishshum shennishtannu mittorat mayim keshennaasa bahem ezo melaka, ukeshehediach o natal bahem yadayv — lo nishtannu mittorat mayim leinyan netilat yadayim). Ulepi sebara zo en issur littol yadayv mimmayim shennatal bahem chabero venitqabbelu lematta bikli, ella mishshum shennitmeu hammayim al yede chabero im lo shapak rebiit bebat achat, umayim hashsheniyyim enan metaharim ella hammayim sheal gabbe hayyad bilbad. Abal im shapak rebiit bebat achat, sheen kan mayim temeim kelal — muttar. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona (dedavqa keshearbaa vachamishsha notelin keachat, shechashubim keyad achat — en chosheshin mishshum melaka, abal belav haki chosheshin). Velaken asur littol bemayim shennatal chabero venitqabbelu lematta bikli, apillu shapak rebiit bebat achat, mippene shennaasa bahem melaka, shettiharu hayyadayim laakila, venaasu shopekin:

Abal hayyotze mibbet hakkisse — yakol lishob bechopnayv mayim min haddeli letaher yadayv, ushear hammayim shebbaddeli kesherim lintilat yadayim lasseuda (mippene shello tiher yadayv bammayim hannisharim baddeli ella bammayim shebbechopnayv. Abal im hitbilan baddeli letaharan — hare naasa melaka bekol hammayim shebbaddeli. Vaapillu lo hayu yadayv meluklakot mammash, mikkol maqom, kevan sheyyesh lo tzorek lenaqqotan bemayim mishshum shennageu bimqom hattinnopet — naasu hammayim keshopekin, kemo hammishtammesh bahem shear debarim shehu tzorek lo, apillu hu debar hareshut, kemo shennitbaer lemala, kol shekken niqqayon zeh shehu choba, veeno domeh lehadiach kelim mudachim, sheen tzorek bahadacha zo):

Mayim shellipne hannappach, ap al pi shello nishtannu marehem — pesulim, mippene shebbeyadua shenneesta bahem melaka, dehaynu shekkibba bahem barzel. Veshellipne hassappar, im nishtannu marehem — pesulim, veim lav — kesherim, ki mah shehassappar tobel yadayv bahem lehashrot bahem hassearot — domeh letobel yado vetach pene haggeluseqim, shemmayim hannisharim lo naasa bahem melaka:

Mayim kesherim shennatan letokan meat mayim pesulim — betelim berob. Vaapillu im happesulim mashlimim leshiur rebiit — en lachosh bintilat yadayim lechullin. Lepikak, mayim sheshshatu mehem behema chayya vaop — en leposlam mishshum meleket hashshetiyya shenneesta bimat mayim shehuchzar mippihem lakkeli, kemo shehu derek behema chayya vaop bishtiyyatan, shemmagbihin pihem leachar sheqqaletu min hammayim vehammayim nopelin mippihem, ki mayim ellu betelim berubbam. Veyesh poselim beshata mehem keleb o chazir, mippene shennimasim, vahare hem keshopekim. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem:

En hammelaka poselet ella bemayim sheubin, ben shehem bekelim ben shehem beqarqa, keshenneesta bahem hammelaka, veachar kak notelan bikli littol mehem. Abal im asa melaka beme miqveh o mayan beodam mechubbarim — lo nipselu. Abal shinnuy mareh posel gam beodam mechubbarim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Lintilat yadayim, abal lehatbil bahem yadayv — rashshay im kesherim litbilat haggup, kegon mayan, sheen shinnuy mareh posel bo, o miqveh shennishtanna mareh hammayim mechamat dabar sheen bo mammash, kegon hadachat salle zetim vaanabim, o shennapelu letokam me tzeba, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman r"a:

Lo tiqqenu chakamim netila ella bemayim hareuyim lishtiyyat behema, abal mayim meluchim o marim o seruchim ad sheen hakkeleb yakol lishtot mehem — pesulim lintilat yadayim, ap al pi shekkesherim leme miqveh litbilat kol haggup, veen tzarik lomar litbilat yadayim. Veim hem akurim mechamat tit shennitareb bahem, im hakkeleb yakol lishtot mehem — kesherim, ben lintilat yadayim ben litbila, veim en hakkeleb yakol lishtot mehen — pesulim lishtehem:

Chamme teberya hem marim veen reuyim lishtiyyat hakkeleb ap likshemmetzannenam, lepikak, en notelin mehem layyadayim. Abal matbilin bahem keshehem bimqom qebiutan, apillu en bahem m' sea, shehammayan metaher bekol shehu. Abal im himshik otam baaretz derek charitz shebbaqqarqa chutz limqomam vehipsiqan mehammayan hannobea chom — en matbilin bahen im en bahem m' sea. Apillu lehaomerim sheen tzarik m' sea litbilat yadayim bishar me miqveh, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"t — kan gazeru shemma yittol mehem gam ken bikli, ki yomar: mah li littol mehem layyadayim bikli, mah li lehatbil hayyadayim betokan, kevan sheen bahem m' sea upasul litbilat kol haggup, veap al pi ken kesherim layyadayim, abal kesheyyesh bahem m' sea shehu shiur miqveh — lo yabo lehaqel littol mehem bikli mimmah shemmeqillin lehatbil bahem kesheyyesh bahem shiur miqveh ureuyim litbilat kol haggup. Lepikak, charitz shemmemayv mechubbarim leme hammayan hannobea chom beinyan sherauy litbol bo kol haggup — matbilin bo et hayyadayim. Veyesh omerim sheap bazeh yesh lachosh shemma yabo lehaqel littol mehem bikli, lepi shello yaaleh al dato shemmemayv mechubbarim leme hammayan, veyomar: mah li littol mimmennu bikli, mah li lehatbil betoko, kevan sheen bo shiur miqveh shehu m' sea. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla:

Velo chamme teberya bilbad, ella hu haddin kol mayim sheen reuyin lishtiyyat keleb veen bahem m' sea, ap al pi shehem mechubbarim lemiqveh sheyyesh bo m' sea — yesh lehachamir shello lehatbil bahem. Vekol mayim sheruyim lishtiyyat hakkeleb keshehem tzonenim, apillu hem mayanot chammin — notelin mehen apillu bikli, vekol shekken chamme haur apillu beodan chammin. Ume hayyam hen meluchin veenan reuyim lishtiyyat hakkeleb, veen notelin mehen layyadayim bikli, ella im ken hirtichu otam, sheaz reuyim:

Sapeq naasa melaka bammayim shennatal bahem sapeq lo naasa bahem, veim timtze lomar shello naasa bahem, sapeq haya bahem keshiur sapeq lo hayu yadayv tehorot, vaapillu sapeq natal yadayv sapeq lo natal — tahor. Vekol sapeq betohorat yadayim — tahor, apillu bemachaloqet happoseqim, mippene shennetilat yadayim iqqarah middibre soperim, usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Veyesh mi sheomer, sheim kol zeh im yesh lo mayim acherim mezummanim lepanayv — omerim lo: qum urechatz vehotzi atzmeka min hassapeq. (Abal im yodea shennatal kahalaka veachar kak nolad bahen sapeq, kegon shennistappeq im hissiach dato mehem im lav, o sheyyodea shello hissiach dato raq shehoshit yadayv samuk limqom hattinnopet vesapeq im naga bahem sapeq lo naga — en tzarik lachazor velittelan apillu latzet yede sapeq, mippene shemmaamidin otan bechezqatan):

Hashsheleg vehabbarad vehakkepor vehaggelid vehammelach, im risseqan ad shennaasu mayim — notelin mehem layyadayim im yesh bahem keshiur. Veken notelin bekol dabar shebberiyyato min hammayim, kegon yabchushim adummim o shumman dag, vehu sherisseqan ad shennaasu mayim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennotel bikli veshopek al yadayv — az tzarik rissuq, sheen netilat yadayim ella bemayim, abal lehatbil yadayv bem' sea shebbaqqarqa — yesh mattirin apillu belo rissuq. Vesheleg hammunnach al pene haaretz, kol sheyyesh m' sea mechubbar yachad apillu namuk meod — muttar lehatbil bo. Veyesh omerim sheen tebila ella bemayim, ella shehashsheleg vekayyotze bo mitztorpin lehashlim lem' sea ap al pi sheenan merussaqim, abal en tobelin bahem ella im ken risseqan ad shennaasu mayim. Ubishat haddechaq, yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Yesh omerim sheen netilat yadayim ella bemayim velo bishar mashqin ume perot, lepi sheasu netilat yadayim lechullin kitbila litruma, veen osin miqveh ella min hammayim, vahare apillu mayim sheen bahem mareh mayim pesulim, kol shekken shear mashqin ume perot (vaapillu yayin laban sheddomeh marito lemareh mayim, mikkol maqom, im hiqpidu al mareh mayim — kol shekken al gup hammayim). Veyesh makshirin kol me perot lintilat yadayim, shello paselu shinnuy mareh ella bemayim shennishtannu mimmaritam, abal me perot sheomedim bemaritam — shem mayim alehem, shehare niqra "me perot". Abal beyayin, apillu laban — en notelin bo, ben chay ben mazug bemayim, sheen shem mayim alayv kelal. Veen tzarik lomar beshemen udebash, shehare enam menaqqim. Abal beme debash (sheqqorin ma"d) veshekar notelin [mehen layyadayim], shehare iqqaran mayim. Veap al pi shennishtannu marehem — en lachosh, kevan shennishtannu leilluy. Veyesh omerim sheap hayyayin kasher lintilat yadayim, ben chay ben mazug bemayim, ella shellekattechilla asur laasot ken, kede shello yehe mezalzel bedabar chashub shennishtanna leilluy, ad sheqqobea beraka leatzmo lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" (mah sheen ken bishar me perot, shemmuttar littol bahem im en lo mayim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"a vqp"a). Abal bediabad im natal beyayin, apillu adom — yadayv tehorot. Ubishat haddechaq, yesh lismok al dibre hammeqillin bedibre soperim littol yadayv beme perot veshekar u[me] debash apillu lekattechilla (ubeyayin bediabad):

Shiur hammayim shennotelin mehem layyadayim hu, lo pachot merebiit hallog (vehu shiur tohora min hattora litbilat kelim). Velo hitzriku ella sheyyehe rebiit bakkeli shennotel mimmennu, abal en tzarik lishpok kol harebiit al yadayv, ella im ken rotzeh letaharan bishtipa achat, abal im rotzeh lishpok alehem mayim rishonim usheniyyim — en tzarik ella kede sheyyaspiqu bekol paam limshoach bekol happereq hatztzarik netilat yadayim. Umayim hannisharim bakkeli shennatal mimmennu — yakol littol mehem ish acher im maspiqim lo, ap al pi sheen bahem rebiit, hoil vehem baim mishshiyyure tohora shehaya bahem rebiit keshennatal harishon. Vehu shebbaim shenehem littol yedehem keechad, ap al pi shennotelin zeh achar zeh — moil shiyyure tohora shel rishon letaher yad hashsheni bepachot merebiit. Veyesh omerim sheen shiyyure tohora shel harishon moilin benotelin zeh achar zeh, ella im ken hammayim yoredim beqilluach echad min harishon lashsheni, kegon sheppashat harishon yadayv littol veacher yotzeq al yadayv, veachar kak pashat hashsheni yadayv lematta mide harishon veqilluach yored al yadayv shel rishon umehen leyadayv shel sheni — yede shettehen tehorot, ap al pi shennipchat shiur harebiit bakkeli keshemmaggiim hammayim leyadayv shel sheni — tehorot, mippene shehem baim mishshiyyure tohora. Vehu sheppashat hashsheni yadayv samuk lide harishon, sheaz hen nechshabot keyad achat, abal im hayu meruchaqot mide harishon —lo olta lo netila, lepi shehu notel beme rechitzat chabero (shehem pesulim apillu hem me rebiit, mishshum shennaasa bahem melaka, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Vaapillu yedehen semukot lo hittiru, ella keshennitkavvenu mittechilla littol keachat al yede qilluach hayyored merishon lesheni, sheaz chashubot yedehen keyad achat bintila zo, ap al pi shello pashat hashsheni yadayv ad achar shehitchil kebar harishon littol yadayv, abal im mittechilla nitkavven harishon littol leatzmo, veachar kak, keshehitchil kebar littol, pashat hashsheni yadayv lematta mimmennu — enan chashubot keyad achat. Ulepikak (im en hayyotzeq al yedehem shopek rebiit bebat achat) — nitmeu yede hashsheni mimmayim hattemeim sheyyoredim mide harishon, vetzarik lenaggeban velachazor velittelan (veap im shopek rebiit bebat achat — tzarik lachazor velittelan, ella sheen tzarik lenaggeban techilla). (Vehaiqqar kassebara haacharona. Umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehaqel bedibre soperim):

Abal yoter mishshenayim enan yekolim littol merebiit, vaapillu merebiit umechetza, ad sheyyihyeh chatzi log, sheap shello hiqpidu chakamim al shiur hammayim sheyyaggiu leyadayv raq sheyyihyeh rebiit bakkeli, mikkol maqom, chashu chakamim im yittelu rabbim mimmayim muatim, shemma lo yedaqdequ yapeh littol kol happereq, shekkol echad yetzamtzem hammayim kede sheyyishshaer lachabero. Ak im haya rebiit umechetza, venatal harishon chatzi rebiit venishar bakkeli rebiit — yekolim shenayim littol merebiit zo al derek shennitbaer, kemo illu hayeta rebiit lebaddah mittechilla bakkeli. Umechatzi log yekolim littol apillu d' al derek shennitbaer, velo Hashem, shemma yetzamtzemu hammayim. Umillog yekolim littol kamma bene adam, kol zeman shemmaspiqin hammayim lishpok kol echad veechad al yadayv g' peamim o b' peamim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qs"b. Vehu haddin sheyyekolim d' veHashem lehanniach yedehem zeh betzad zeh o zeh al gabbe zeh velittol keechad, shekkullan chashubot keyad achat veen metammeot zo et zo. Ubilbad sheyyarpu yedehem, beinyan sheyyaggiu hammayim lekol yad vayad beli shum chatzitzat yad acheret:

Shiur rebiit sheameru, tzarik sheyyehe mekunnas bemaqom echad, sheim natal mishsheminit vechazar venatal mishsheminit (vaapillu natal mishshettehen bebat achat, kegon sheacherim yotzeqim al yado vehaqqilluach mitareb) — yadayv temeot kemo shehayu:

Rebiit sheameru, ben lenotel b' yadayv ben lenotel yado achat bilbad, ben leyadayv shel gadol ben leyadayv shel qatan. Natelu b' bene adam zeh yado achat vezeh yado achat, veachar kak chazar hashsheni venatal yado hashshenit — hare ellu keg' bene adam, sheyyado hashshenit necheshebet keyad adam acher, kevan shello natal mittechilla ella yado achat. Ulepikak, im haya bakkeli chatzi log — yadayv tehorot, veim lav — en yado hashsheniyya tehora, sheen notelin bepachot mechatzi log yoter mishshene bene adam, shemma yetzamtzemu hammayim, vekan yesh lachosh gam ken shemma yetzamtzem, kevan sheeno notel shette yadayv keachat:
